sourceReviewDetails: We checked first and last days, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, non-student days, student return dates, grading-period dates, semester dates, and the published local calendar notes against the HCPS calendar sources.
The 180 student-day total was verified against the board-approved PDF.
The calendar was approved by the School Board on July 14, 2026.

HCPS lists Fall Break during Thanksgiving week, November 22–26, 2027. This page uses the parent-friendly phrase Fall Break (Thanksgiving week) to preserve the official label while making the timing clear.
The 2027–28 calendar also says August 16, 2027, will be a regular student day with no early release.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the first day of school for HCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school is Tuesday, August 10, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for HCPS in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Friday, May 26, 2028, with a 2.5-hour early release. Other student early-release dates have not yet been finalized.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for HCPS in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break is November 22–26, 2027. It falls during Thanksgiving week, and students return Monday, November 29.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 20–31, 2027. January 3 is a non-student day, and students return Tuesday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Spring Break, and when do students return?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 13–17, 2028. Students are also off Monday, March 20, so classes resume Tuesday, March 21.

calendarFaqs.q: Is August 16, 2027, an HCPS early-release day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The HCPS 2027–28 calendar states that Monday, August 16, 2027, will be a regular student day with no early release.

calendarFaqs.q: Can HCPS use scheduled days as hurricane make-up days in 2027–28?
calendarFaqs.a: Yes. HCPS identifies November 11, November 22–24, and January 3 as tentative hurricane make-up dates if needed. Check the district calendar before making plans around those dates.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the ICS file update automatically?
calendarFaqs.a: No. The ICS file is a one-time import and will not automatically sync with later HCPS revisions.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can families check for 2027–28 calendar updates?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official HCPS 2027–28 calendar page and school announcements for final confirmation of revisions, emergency schedule changes, and school-specific dates.
